rows.reason: Gate A round 4 ruling 4, relaxed at the round 4 close

rows.name: ceiling_rate_fpm
rows.reason: the definition of the service ceiling in R12

rows.name: takeoff_minutes
rows.reason: mission-profile allowance (warm-up and take-off at full power); part of the mission the fuel is sized for, like the segments of R5

rows.name: propeller_rpm
rows.reason: datum of the chosen engine's gearbox (ruling R-b)

rows.name: tip_speed_limit_fps
rows.reason: design rule that sets the propeller diameter

rows.name: installed_engine_factor
rows.reason: the installed weight of this engine in this airframe is not known; the factor is a general-aviation average
rows.why_no_proposal: the ledger's source gives one value. The +-5 % empty-weight band (ruling B-2a) covers it in aggregate; a band of its own would count the same uncertainty twice unless that band is narrowed
rows.carried_under: B-9g (empty weight is a named risk)

rows.name: fuel_density_lb_gal
rows.reason: a fuel property that varies with temperature and batch; it sets the tank volume needed, not the fuel weight
rows.why_no_proposal: no range in the ledger's source; the tank-volume margin is what matters and P3 checks it on the loft

rows.name: airfoil_efficiency
rows.reason: section lift-curve slope over 2 pi; it sets the wing lift slope and with it the gust load factor
rows.why_no_proposal: P2 reads the lift-curve slope of the chosen section from measured data; the band should come from that reading

rows.name: wing_x_c_max_t
rows.reason: geometry of the wing section, fixed when P2 fixes the section (PD-5)

rows.name: flap_delta_cl_max
rows.reason: the flap's lift increment sets the take-off and landing C_L,max; one table value
rows.why_no_proposal: the ledger's source gives one value. P2 uses the same table for the flapped increment, so no package measures it
rows.carried_under: item 1 covers the clean value only; the flapped increment stays an assumption

rows.name: roughness_k_ft
rows.reason: surface finish in service; enters every skin-friction coefficient
rows.why_no_proposal: no range in the ledger's source
rows.carried_under: G-3, B-5 (item 14: CD0 has no second route)

rows.name: leakage_fraction
rows.reason: it multiplies the whole parasite drag; the drag build-up has no band of its own, and Gate B found that its method resolves CD0 to about +-20 % (G-3)
rows.why_no_proposal: the width is the owner's choice: this entry is the natural carrier of a CD0 band, because the info-gap study has none. The package records what +10 % on CD0 costs (leakage_fraction 0.155)

rows.name: tail_interference_q
rows.basis: the range printed in the entry's own source text

rows.name: tail_eta_h
rows.reason: dynamic-pressure ratio at the tail; it scales the tail's contribution to the neutral point and to trim, behind a pusher propeller
rows.why_no_proposal: the ledger's source gives 'about 0.9' and no range; the slipstream at the tail is out of scope (NR-16)
rows.carried_under: NR-16 (out of scope); P4 uses the value

rows.name: engine_sfc_allowance
rows.reason: ruling R-b. The uncertainty of the SFC is the banded engine_sfc_mult of the info-gap study, on top of this allowance

rows.name: c_ht
rows.reason: sizing rule for the first tail size; the tail is then enlarged for rotation and P4 checks the result

rows.name: c_vt
rows.reason: sizing rule for the vertical tail. No requirement checks its result (PD-11: no lateral-directional analysis)

rows.name: gear_load_factor_ultimate
rows.reason: design rule in the gear weight equation

rows.name: wing_tank_usable
rows.reason: usable share of the tank box volume
rows.why_no_proposal: the ledger's source gives one value; P3 measures the tank volume on the loft

rows.name: cl_ground
rows.reason: lift coefficient in the ground attitude; it enters the ground roll and the rotation moment. The source's value is for an aircraft without large flaps, and the take-off is flown with the flap at 30 deg
rows.basis: the entry's own source text ('usually below 0.1'); the upper end is not covered by it for a deflected flap, which is why a band is needed

rows.name: climb_speed_over_stall
rows.reason: speed rule: the lowest climb speed

rows.name: tyre_drag_per_area
rows.reason: gear drag with the gear down (take-off and landing)
rows.basis: the two values in the entry's own source text (faired and regular wheel)

rows.name: strut_drag_per_area
rows.reason: gear drag with the gear down
rows.why_no_proposal: the ledger's source gives one value

rows.name: gear_interference
rows.reason: gear drag with the gear down
rows.basis: the entry's own source text: 1.2 for mutual interference, 1.284 with the 7 % for open wells

rows.name: flap_cp_fraction
rows.reason: centre of pressure of the flap's lift; it enters the rotation moment, whose margin is thin (item 25)
rows.basis: the range printed in the entry's own source text

rows.name: main_wheel_load_fraction
rows.reason: rule for sizing the tyres; P4 computes the wheel loads of the layout

acceptance.what: every number is read from r0: the design sized again by the script equals r0, field by field
the compliance matrix has no blank row
the weight statement sums to the record's empty weight
the V-n diagram's points equal r0's vn entries
out-of-calibration list: not empty, and every correlation flagged on 2026-11-25 is in it or has a reason
risk list: not empty, and every risk names the package that measures it or the ruling that carries it
trades (NR-3): the nominal case of each trade is r0 (re-sized weight; hours of the built aircraft)

App. L decomposition on r0 (NR-1) and the climb speed at the worst endurance corner (item 18): Stage 1's climb speed at or above 1.2 V_stall at the mission altitude; integrated climb within 1 % of the mission fuel
concept record at these sizes (NR-4, A9): the scoring does not reverse
empty weight (items 8, 27): the Table 15.2 groups sum to the record's value and the steps close
band audit (item 28): every ledger entry without a band is classed
payload bay, first check (item 30, PD-12): the payload volume is inside the free volume of the Stage 1 body
